title: Jubilant Italian Polish Sausage Cassata
description: A rich and indulgent Italian dish featuring Polish sausage, soffritto base, and vegetarian friendly ingredients, all layered in a cassata form within an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the chopped onions, carrots, and celery until they are softened.
Add the Polish sausage to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is no longer pink.
Stir in the tomato sauce and bring the mixture to a simmer.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, egg, and chopped basil.
In a separate bowl, combine the shredded mozzarella cheese and a pinch of salt.
In an earthenware bowl, create a layer of the sausage and tomato sauce mixture.
Top the sausage layer with a layer of the ricotta cheese mixture.
Sprinkle a layer of the mozzarella cheese mixture over the ricotta layer.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of mozzarella cheese on top.
Cover the earthenware bowl with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
